decision_supported: rank candidate anime for a user based on scored liked anime, while allowing product filters and profile-band-aware recommendation modes
chance_floor: random_uniform: sanity baseline for top-k ranking under sampled candidates
baseline: popularity_baseline: globally common liked anime in training data
stronger_system: latent_svd and hybrid_svd_popularity: personalized collaborative models that should beat random and popularity baselines
product_safe_system: hybrid_svd_popularity: latent collaborative SVD score blended with popularity for safer sparse-profile recommendations

user_levels.primary_signal: cold-start onboarding, genre filters, popularity, score, short entry points
user_levels.risk: no reliable personal vector; collaborative filtering needs a popularity/content fallback

user_levels.primary_signal: genre onboarding, recognizable popular titles, short lists, early content similarity
user_levels.risk: some watched anime exist, but the profile is still too small for a stable latent taste vector

user_levels.primary_signal: similar anime, relation navigation, popularity prior, high-rated anchors
user_levels.risk: taste is still forming; the model can overfit to a few early favorites

user_levels.primary_signal: collaborative filtering, relation continuation, content/tag similarity, current discovery
user_levels.risk: model should balance familiar taste with controlled exploration

user_levels.primary_signal: collaborative ranking, niche clusters, relation navigation, controlled novelty
user_levels.risk: the user knows many common recommendations, so repetition becomes more visible

user_levels.primary_signal: collaborative ranking, niche clusters, graph-aware expansion, seasonal/current discovery
user_levels.risk: many obvious items are already known; recommendations need novelty and coverage

user_levels.primary_signal: long-tail discovery, novelty, obscure catalog coverage, graph-aware exploration
user_levels.risk: hardest group: exact recovery is difficult and obvious catalog items are saturated

control_filters.content_rating_filter: G, PG, PG-13, R, R+, Rx
control_filters.explicit_toggle: exclude or include Ecchi/Erotica/Hentai and explicit tags
control_filters.score_floor: minimum MAL score when a user wants safer picks
control_filters.episode_length_filter: episode count and total watchtime ranges
control_filters.year_filter: release year or season recency range

level_policy_note: Level thresholds are product rules based on completed/known entries. Offline evaluation approximates this with known liked ratings because the Kaggle source has ratings but no chronological watch history.
ratings_source_note: The stable interaction layer is the 2020 Kaggle MAL ratings dataset. A separate current-user ratings collector is being built for a later deliverable, but it is not yet used for this benchmark.

candidate_pool.definition: catalog anime with at least 20 positive ratings in the filtered interaction layer

train_test_logic: per eligible user, one liked anime is deterministically held out; the user's remaining liked anime stay in training
leakage_note: held-out user-item pairs are removed from the training matrix; no timestamp claims are made because the rating source has no event time

guardrails: block candidates whose prerequisite is only plan-to-watch
block candidates whose prerequisite was rated below the like threshold
block side/special content unless the parent prerequisite is liked
